summary.text: Jack Codiga, a Republican finance professional, lost the November 3, 2026 election for North Carolina's 12th Congressional District to Alma Adams.
A California native who moved to Charlotte in 2021, he works in finance as an associate producer at the mortgage lender Medalist Capital and has not previously held elected office.

paragraphs.text: Jack Codiga graduated from Scotts Valley High School and earned a bachelor's degree in finance from Santa Clara University's Leavey School of Business.
He moved to Charlotte from California in 2021, according to WFAE's 2026 voter guide, which lists his age as approximately 28.
Codiga works in finance; WFAE lists his occupation as associate producer at Medalist Capital, a mortgage lender, and he describes himself as "a Christian, finance professional, and proud American."
He has no previous experience in elected office, according to WFAE, and won the March 3, 2026 Republican primary over Addul Ali with 67.4% of the vote.
His campaign website called for abolishing the Federal Reserve and returning to gold- and silver-backed money.
He received 18.8% of the vote to Alma Adams's 81.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
